annotations.title: Check or change the store look (Shopify)

description: Shows or changes the store look shopify-pack images are made in, so a whole catalogue matches: backdrop colour and type, accent colour, light, image shape, model notes and an optional reference photo from the person’s store. Each brand kit can have its own look (brand_kit_id); a brand without one, and a set without a brand, use the account’s look (own: false says a brand uses it). Call without fields to see it; send only the fields to change. Free. Returns the saved look. Example: {"brand_kit_id": "…", "backdrop_color": "#E8E2DA", "ratio": "4:5"}

accent_color.description: Hex for small props and type; null for none

brand_kit_id.description: A brand kit from list_brand_kits; leave out for the account’s own look

model_look.description: How models look, e.g. "women in their 20s, athletic"

ratio.description: auto (default: the product type’s shape: square; 4:5 clothing, home, pet, gifts; 3:4 shoes), or 1:1, 4:5, 3:4 or 5:6 for every image

reference_image_base64.description: A photo from the person’s store (JPG, PNG or WebP) to match: backdrop, light, crop

name: store_look
title: Check or change the store look (Shopify)
